verses.en: Samuel also said unto Saul, The LORD sent me to anoint thee to be king over his people, over Israel: now therefore hearken thou unto the voice of the words of the LORD.
verses.pt: Disse Samuel a Saul: Enviou-me o Senhor a ungir-te rei sobre o seu povo, sobre Israel; ouve, pois, agora as palavras do Senhor.
verses.en_web: Samuel said to Saul, “Yahweh sent me to anoint you to be king over his people, over Israel. Now therefore listen to the voice of Yahweh’s words.
verses.en_bbe: And Samuel said to Saul, The Lord sent me to put the holy oil on you and to make you king over his people, over Israel: so give ear now to the words of the Lord.

verses.en: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, I remember that which Amalek did to Israel, how he laid wait for him in the way, when he came up from Egypt.
verses.pt: Assim diz o Senhor dos exércitos: Castigarei a Amaleque por aquilo que fez a Israel quando se lhe opôs no caminho, ae subir ele do Egito.
verses.en_web: Yahweh of Armies says, ‘I remember what Amalek did to Israel, how he set himself against him on the way, when he came up out of Egypt.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord of armies says, I will give punishment to Amalek for what he did to Israel, fighting against him on the way when Israel came out of Egypt.

verses.en: Now go and smite Amalek, and utterly destroy all that they have, and spare them not; but slay both man and woman, infant and suckling, ox and sheep, camel and ass.
verses.pt: Vai, pois, agora e fere a Amaleque, e o destrói totalmente com tudo o que tiver; não o poupes, porém matarás homens e mulheres, meninos e crianças de peito, bois e ovelhas, camelos e jumentos.
verses.en_web: Now go and strike Amalek, and utterly destroy all that they have, and don’t spare them; but kill both man and woman, infant and nursing baby, ox and sheep, camel and donkey.’”
verses.en_bbe: Go now and put Amalek to the sword, putting to the curse all they have, without mercy: put to death every man and woman, every child and baby at the breast, every ox and sheep, camel and ass.

verses.en: And Saul gathered the people together, and numbered them in Telaim, two hundred thousand footmen, and ten thousand men of Judah.
verses.pt: Então Saul convocou o povo, e os contou em Telaim, duzentos mil homens de infantaria, e mais dez mil dos de Judá.
verses.en_web: Saul summoned the people, and counted them in Telaim, two hundred thousand footmen, and ten thousand men of Judah.
verses.en_bbe: And Saul sent for the people and had them numbered in Telaim, two hundred thousand footmen and ten thousand men of Judah.

verses.en: And Saul came to a city of Amalek, and laid wait in the valley.
verses.pt: Chegando, pois, Saul à cidade de Amaleque, pôs uma emboscada no vale.
verses.en_web: Saul came to the city of Amalek, and set an ambush in the valley.
verses.en_bbe: And Saul came to the town of Amalek, and took up his position in the valley secretly.

verses.en: And Saul said unto the Kenites, Go, depart, get you down from among the Amalekites, lest I destroy you with them: for ye shewed kindness to all the children of Israel, when they came up out of Egypt. So the Kenites departed from among the Amalekites.
verses.pt: E disse Saul aos queneus: Ide, retirai-vos, saí do meio dos amalequitas, para que eu não vos destrua juntamente com eles; porque vós usastes de misericórdia com todos os filhos de Israel, quando subiram do Egito. Retiraram-se, pois, os queneus do meio dos amalequitas.
verses.en_web: Saul said to the Kenites, “Go, depart, go down from among the Amalekites, lest I destroy you with them; for you showed kindness to all the children of Israel, when they came up out of Egypt.” So the Kenites departed from among the Amalekites.
verses.en_bbe: And Saul said to the Kenites, Go away, take yourselves out from among the Amalekites, or destruction will overtake you with them: for you were kind to the children of Israel when they came out of Egypt. So the Kenites went away from among the Amalekites.

verses.en: And Saul smote the Amalekites from Havilah until thou comest to Shur, that is over against Egypt.
verses.pt: Depois Saul feriu os amalequitas desde Havilá até chegar a Sur, que está defronte do Egito.
verses.en_web: Saul struck the Amalekites, from Havilah as you go to Shur, that is before Egypt.
verses.en_bbe: And Saul made an attack on the Amalekites from Havilah on the road to Shur, which is before Egypt.

verses.en: And he took Agag the king of the Amalekites alive, and utterly destroyed all the people with the edge of the sword.
verses.pt: E tomou vivo a Agague, rei dos amalequitas, porém a todo o povo destruiu ao fio da espada.
verses.en_web: He took Agag the king of the Amalekites alive, and utterly destroyed all the people with the edge of the sword.
verses.en_bbe: He took Agag, king of the Amalekites, prisoner, and put all the people to the sword without mercy.

verses.en: But Saul and the people spared Agag, and the best of the sheep, and of the oxen, and of the fatlings, and the lambs, and all that was good, and would not utterly destroy them: but every thing that was vile and refuse, that they destroyed utterly.
verses.pt: Mas Saul e o povo pouparam a Agague, como também ao melhor das ovelhas, dos bois, e dos animais engordados, e aos cordeiros, e a tudo o que era bom, e não os quiseram destruir totalmente; porém a tudo o que era vil e desprezível destruíram totalmente.
verses.en_web: But Saul and the people spared Agag, and the best of the sheep, of the cattle, and of the fat calves, and the lambs, and all that was good, and were not willing to utterly destroy them; but everything that was vile and refuse, that they destroyed utterly.
verses.en_bbe: But Saul and the people did not put Agag to death, and they kept the best of the sheep and the oxen and the fat beasts and the lambs, and whatever was good, not desiring to put them to the curse: but everything which was bad and of no use they put to the curse.

verses.en: Then came the word of the LORD unto Samuel, saying,
verses.pt: Então veio a palavra do Senhor a Samuel, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Then Yahweh’s word came to Samuel, saying,
verses.en_bbe: Then the Lord said to Samuel,

verses.en: It repenteth me that I have set up Saul to be king: for he is turned back from following me, and hath not performed my commandments. And it grieved Samuel; and he cried unto the LORD all night.
verses.pt: Arrependo-me de haver posto a Saul como rei; porquanto deixou de me seguir, e não cumpriu as minhas palavras. Então Samuel se contristou, e clamou ao Senhor a noite toda.
verses.en_web: “It grieves me that I have set up Saul to be king; for he has turned back from following me, and has not performed my commandments.” Samuel was angry; and he cried to Yahweh all night.
verses.en_bbe: It is no longer my pleasure for Saul to be king; for he is turned back from going in my ways, and has not done my orders. And Samuel was very sad, crying to the Lord in prayer all night.

verses.en: And when Samuel rose early to meet Saul in the morning, it was told Samuel, saying, Saul came to Carmel, and, behold, he set him up a place, and is gone about, and passed on, and gone down to Gilgal.
verses.pt: E Samuel madrugou para encontrar-se com Saul pela manhã; e foi dito a Samuel: Já chegou Saul ao Carmelo, e eis que levantou para si numa coluna e, voltando, passou e desceu a Gilgal.
verses.en_web: Samuel rose early to meet Saul in the morning; and Samuel was told, saying, “Saul came to Carmel, and behold, he set up a monument for himself, and turned, and passed on, and went down to Gilgal.”
verses.en_bbe: And early in the morning he got up and went to Saul; and word was given to Samuel that Saul had come to Carmel and put up a pillar, and had gone from there down to Gilgal.

verses.en: And Samuel came to Saul: and Saul said unto him, Blessed be thou of the LORD: I have performed the commandment of the LORD.
verses.pt: Veio, pois, Samuel ter com Saul, e Saul lhe disse: Bendito sejas do Senhor; já cumpri a palavra do Senhor.
verses.en_web: Samuel came to Saul; and Saul said to him, “You are blessed by Yahweh! I have performed the commandment of Yahweh.”
verses.en_bbe: And Samuel came to Saul; and Saul said to him, May the blessing of the Lord be with you: I have done what was ordered by the Lord.

verses.en: And Samuel said, What meaneth then this bleating of the sheep in mine ears, and the lowing of the oxen which I hear?
verses.pt: Então perguntou Samuel: Que quer dizer, pois, este balido de ovelhas que chega aos meus ouvidos, e o mugido de bois que ouço?
verses.en_web: Samuel said, “Then what does this bleating of the sheep in my ears, and the lowing of the cattle which I hear mean?”
verses.en_bbe: And Samuel said, What then is this sound of the crying of sheep and the noise of oxen which comes to my ears?

verses.en: And Saul said, They have brought them from the Amalekites: for the people spared the best of the sheep and of the oxen, to sacrifice unto the LORD thy God; and the rest we have utterly destroyed.
verses.pt: Ao que respondeu Saul: De Amaleque os trouxeram, porque o povo guardou o melhor das ovelhas e dos bois, para os oferecer ao Senhor teu Deus; o resto, porém, destruímo-lo totalmente.
verses.en_web: Saul said, “They have brought them from the Amalekites; for the people spared the best of the sheep and of the cattle, to sacrifice to Yahweh your God. We have utterly destroyed the rest.”
verses.en_bbe: And Saul said, They have taken them from the Amalekites: for the people have kept the best of the sheep and of the oxen as an offering to the Lord your God; all the rest we have given up to destruction.

verses.en: Then Samuel said unto Saul, Stay, and I will tell thee what the LORD hath said to me this night. And he said unto him, Say on.
verses.pt: Então disse Samuel a Saul: Espera, e te declararei o que o Senhor me disse esta noite. Respondeu-lhe Saul: Fala.
verses.en_web: Then Samuel said to Saul, “Stay, and I will tell you what Yahweh said to me last night.” He said to him, “Say on.”
verses.en_bbe: Then Samuel said to Saul, Say no more! Let me give you word of what the Lord has said to me this night. And he said to him, Say on.

verses.en: And Samuel said, When thou wast little in thine own sight, wast thou not made the head of the tribes of Israel, and the LORD anointed thee king over Israel?
verses.pt: Prosseguiu, pois, Samuel: Embora pequeno aos teus próprios olhos, porventura não foste feito o cabeça das tribos de Israel? O Senhor te ungiu rei sobre Israel;
verses.en_web: Samuel said, “Though you were little in your own sight, weren’t you made the head of the tribes of Israel? Yahweh anointed you king over Israel;
verses.en_bbe: And Samuel said, Though you may seem little to yourself, are you not head of the tribes of Israel? for the Lord with the holy oil made you king over Israel,

verses.en: And the LORD sent thee on a journey, and said, Go and utterly destroy the sinners the Amalekites, and fight against them until they be consumed.
verses.pt: e bem assim te enviou o Senhor a este caminho, e disse: Vai, e destrói totalmente a estes pecadores, os amalequitas, e peleja contra eles, até que sejam aniquilados.
verses.en_web: and Yahweh sent you on a journey, and said, ‘Go, and utterly destroy the sinners the Amalekites, and fight against them until they are consumed.’
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord sent you on a journey and said, Go and put to the curse those sinners, the Amalekites, fighting against them till every one is dead.

verses.en: Wherefore then didst thou not obey the voice of the LORD, but didst fly upon the spoil, and didst evil in the sight of the LORD?
verses.pt: Por que, pois, não deste ouvidos à voz do Senhor, antes te lançaste ao despojo, e fizeste o que era mau aos olhos do Senhor?
verses.en_web: Why then didn’t you obey Yahweh’s voice, but took the plunder, and did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight?”
verses.en_bbe: Why then did you not do the orders of the Lord, but by violently taking their goods did evil in the eyes of the Lord?

verses.en: And Saul said unto Samuel, Yea, I have obeyed the voice of the LORD, and have gone the way which the LORD sent me, and have brought Agag the king of Amalek, and have utterly destroyed the Amalekites.
verses.pt: Então respondeu Saul a Samuel: Pelo contrário, dei ouvidos à voz do Senhor, e caminhei no caminho pelo qual o Senhor me enviou, e trouxe a Agague, rei de Amaleque, e aos amalequitas destruí totalmente;
verses.en_web: Saul said to Samuel, “But I have obeyed Yahweh’s voice, and have gone the way which Yahweh sent me, and have brought Agag the king of Amalek, and have utterly destroyed the Amalekites.
verses.en_bbe: And Saul said, Truly, I have done the orders of the Lord and have gone the way the Lord sent me; I have taken Agag, the king of Amalek, and have given the Amalekites up to destruction.

verses.en: But the people took of the spoil, sheep and oxen, the chief of the things which should have been utterly destroyed, to sacrifice unto the LORD thy God in Gilgal.
verses.pt: mas o povo tomou do despojo ovelhas e bois, o melhor do anátema, para o sacrificar ao Senhor teu Deus em Gilgal.
verses.en_web: But the people took of the plunder, sheep and cattle, the chief of the devoted things, to sacrifice to Yahweh your God in Gilgal.”
verses.en_bbe: But the people took some of their goods, sheep and oxen, the chief of the things which were put to the curse, to make an offering of them to the Lord your God in Gilgal.

verses.en: And Samuel said, Hath the LORD as great delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices, as in obeying the voice of the LORD? Behold, to obey is better than sacrifice, and to hearken than the fat of rams.
verses.pt: Samuel, porém, disse: Tem, porventura, o Senhor tanto prazer em holocaustos e sacrifícios, como em que se obedeça à voz do Senhor? Eis que o obedecer é melhor do que o sacrificar, e o atender, do que a gordura de carneiros
verses.en_web: Samuel said, “Has Yahweh as great delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices, as in obeying Yahweh’s voice? Behold, to obey is better than sacrifice, and to listen than the fat of rams.
verses.en_bbe: And Samuel said, Has the Lord as much delight in offerings and burned offerings as in the doing of his orders? Truly, to do his pleasure is better than to make offerings, and to give ear to him than the fat of sheep.

verses.en: For rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft, and stubbornness is as iniquity and idolatry. Because thou hast rejected the word of the LORD, he hath also rejected thee from being king.
verses.pt: Porque a rebelião é como o pecado de adivinhação, e a obstinação é como a iniqüidade de idolatria. Porquanto rejeitaste a palavra do Senhor, ele também te rejeitou, a ti, para que não sejas rei.
verses.en_web: For rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft, and stubbornness is as idolatry and teraphim. Because you have rejected Yahweh’s word, he has also rejected you from being king.”
verses.en_bbe: For to go against his orders is like the sin of those who make use of secret arts, and pride is like giving worship to images. Because you have put away from you the word of the Lord, he has put you from your place as king.

verses.en: And Saul said unto Samuel, I have sinned: for I have transgressed the commandment of the LORD, and thy words: because I feared the people, and obeyed their voice.
verses.pt: Então disse Saul a Samuel: Pequei, porquanto transgredi a ordem do Senhor e as tuas palavras; porque temi ao povo, e dei ouvidos a sua voz.
verses.en_web: Saul said to Samuel, “I have sinned; for I have transgressed the commandment of Yahweh, and your words, because I feared the people, and obeyed their voice.
verses.en_bbe: And Saul said to Samuel, Great is my sin: for I have gone against the orders of the Lord and against your words: because, fearing the people, I did what they said.

verses.en: Now therefore, I pray thee, pardon my sin, and turn again with me, that I may worship the LORD.
verses.pt: Agora, pois, perdoa o meu pecado, e volta comigo, para que eu adore ao Senhor.
verses.en_web: Now therefore, please pardon my sin, and turn again with me, that I may worship Yahweh.”
verses.en_bbe: So now, let my sin have forgiveness, and go back with me to give worship to the Lord.

verses.en: And Samuel said unto Saul, I will not return with thee: for thou hast rejected the word of the LORD, and the LORD hath rejected thee from being king over Israel.
verses.pt: Samuel porém disse a Saul: Não voltarei contigo; porquanto rejeitaste a palavra do Senhor, e o Senhor te rejeitou a ti, para que não sejas rei sobre Israel:
verses.en_web: Samuel said to Saul, “I will not return with you; for you have rejected Yahweh’s word, and Yahweh has rejected you from being king over Israel.”
verses.en_bbe: And Samuel said to Saul, I will not go back with you: for you have put away from you the word of the Lord, and the Lord has put you from your place as king over Israel.

verses.en: And as Samuel turned about to go away, he laid hold upon the skirt of his mantle, and it rent.
verses.pt: E, virando-se Samuel para se ir, Saul pegou-lhe pela orla da capa, a qual se rasgou.
verses.en_web: As Samuel turned around to go away, Saul grabbed the skirt of his robe, and it tore.
verses.en_bbe: And when Samuel was turning round to go away, Saul took the skirt of his robe in his hand, and the cloth came away.

verses.en: And Samuel said unto him, The LORD hath rent the kingdom of Israel from thee this day, and hath given it to a neighbour of thine, that is better than thou.
verses.pt: Então Samuel lhe disse: O Senhor rasgou de ti hoje o reino de Israel, e o deu a um teu próximo, que é melhor do que tu.
verses.en_web: Samuel said to him, “Yahweh has torn the kingdom of Israel from you today, and has given it to a neighbor of yours who is better than you.
verses.en_bbe: And Samuel said to him, The Lord has taken away the kingdom of Israel from you this day by force, and has given it to a neighbour of yours who is better than you.

verses.en: And also the Strength of Israel will not lie nor repent: for he is not a man, that he should repent.
verses.pt: Também aquele que é a Força de Israel não mente nem se arrepende, por quanto não é homem para que se arrependa.
verses.en_web: Also the Strength of Israel will not lie nor repent; for he is not a man, that he should repent.”
verses.en_bbe: And further, the Glory of Israel will not say what is false, and his purpose may not be changed: for he is not a man, whose purpose may be changed.

verses.en: Then he said, I have sinned: yet honour me now, I pray thee, before the elders of my people, and before Israel, and turn again with me, that I may worship the LORD thy God.
verses.pt: Ao que disse Saul: Pequei; honra-me, porém, agora diante dos anciãos do meu povo, e diante de Israel, e volta comigo, para que eu adore ao Senhor teu Deus.
verses.en_web: Then he said, “I have sinned; yet please honor me now before the elders of my people, and before Israel, and come back with me, that I may worship Yahweh your God.”
verses.en_bbe: Then he said, Great is my sin: but still, give me honour now before the heads of my people and before Israel, and come back with me so that I may give worship to the Lord your God.

verses.en: So Samuel turned again after Saul; and Saul worshipped the LORD.
verses.pt: Então, voltando Samuel, seguiu a Saul, e Saul adorou ao Senhor.
verses.en_web: So Samuel went back with Saul; and Saul worshiped Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: So Samuel went back after Saul, and Saul gave worship to the Lord.

verses.en: Then said Samuel, Bring ye hither to me Agag the king of the Amalekites. And Agag came unto him delicately. And Agag said, Surely the bitterness of death is past.
verses.pt: Então disse Samuel: Trazei-me aqui a Agague, rei dos amalequitas. E Agague veio a ele animosamente; e disse: Certamente já passou a amargura da morte.
verses.en_web: Then Samuel said, “Bring Agag the king of the Amalekites here to me!” Agag came to him cheerfully. Agag said, “Surely the bitterness of death is past.”
verses.en_bbe: Then Samuel said, Make Agag, the king of the Amalekites, come here to me. And Agag came to him shaking with fear. And Agag said, Truly the pain of death is past.

verses.en: And Samuel said, As thy sword hath made women childless, so shall thy mother be childless among women. And Samuel hewed Agag in pieces before the LORD in Gilgal.
verses.pt: Disse, porém, Samuel: Assim como a tua espada desfilhou a mulheres, assim ficará desfilhada tua mãe entre as mulheres. E Samuel despedaçou a Agague perante o Senhor em Gilgal.
verses.en_web: Samuel said, “As your sword has made women childless, so your mother will be childless among women!” Then Samuel cut Agag in pieces before Yahweh in Gilgal.
verses.en_bbe: And Samuel said, As your sword has made women without children, so now your mother will be without children among women. And Agag was cut up by Samuel, bone from bone, before the Lord in Gilgal.

verses.en: Then Samuel went to Ramah; and Saul went up to his house to Gibeah of Saul.
verses.pt: Então Samuel se foi a Ramá; e Saul subiu a sua casa, a Gibeá de Saul.
verses.en_web: Then Samuel went to Ramah; and Saul went up to his house to Gibeah of Saul.
verses.en_bbe: Then Samuel went to Ramah; and Saul went up to his house in Gibeah, in the land of Saul.

verses.en: And Samuel came no more to see Saul until the day of his death: nevertheless Samuel mourned for Saul: and the LORD repented that he had made Saul king over Israel.
verses.pt: Ora, Samuel nunca mais viu a Saul até o dia da sua morte, mas Samuel teve dó de Saul. E o Senhor se arrependeu de haver posto a Saul rei sobre Israel.
verses.en_web: Samuel came no more to see Saul until the day of his death; for Samuel mourned for Saul: and Yahweh grieved that he had made Saul king over Israel.
verses.en_bbe: And Samuel never saw Saul again till the day of his death; but Samuel was sorrowing for Saul: and it was no longer the Lord's pleasure for Saul to be king over Israel.
